title: ICAI Announces Online Assessment Test for Certificate Course on NBFCs (August 9, 2026)
content:
# ICAI Announces Online Assessment Test for Certificate Course on NBFCs (August 9, 2026)

Ek important update hai for our members! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Certificate Course on Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) ke liye Online Assessment Test ki details announce ki hain. This test is scheduled for August 9, 2026.

Here are the key details regarding this upcoming assessment:

*   **Examination Date:** The Online Assessment Test (Paper I) for the Certificate Course on NBFCs will be held on **Sunday, August 9, 2026**.
*   **Timing:** The test is scheduled from **10:00 AM to 12:00 PM (IST)**.
*   **Mode:** The examination will be conducted **online** through the ICAI Digital Learning Hub.
*   **Organizing Committee:** This test is organized by the Financial Markets and Investors' Awareness Committee (FMIAC) of ICAI.
*   **Notification Date:** The official announcement regarding this assessment test was made on **July 23, 2026**.
*   **Syllabus & Pattern:** The test, consisting of 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) for 100 marks, will cover all chapters of the NBFC certificate course curriculum.
*   **Mandatory Requirement:** Candidates must complete the mandatory Face Registration/Authentication process at least two days before the examination, by 1:30 PM. No extensions will be granted for this.
